name: Greenline Movers & Junk Removal
website_text:
Greenline Movers & Junk Removal
Local moving and junk hauling done right.
Hours: Mon-Sat 7am-7pm, closed Sunday
Service area: Austin, Round Rock, Pflugerville, Cedar Park, Georgetown
We are licensed and insured. Same-week booking is usually available.

faq.question: Do you move pianos or other heavy specialty items?
faq.answer: We move upright pianos with advance notice; grand pianos we refer to a specialty partner. Let me know the type and I'll get you a firm answer.

faq.question: What areas do you serve?
faq.answer: We cover Austin, Round Rock, Pflugerville, Cedar Park, and Georgetown.

faq.question: What are your hours?
faq.answer: We run Monday through Saturday, 7am to 7pm, and we're closed Sundays.

faq.question: What junk will you take and what won't you take?
faq.answer: We take furniture, appliances, yard debris, and general household clutter. We can't take hazardous waste, wet paint, or chemicals.

faq.question: How do I get a quote or price estimate?
faq.answer: Pricing depends on volume and access, so the office puts together a written estimate after a quick photo or call. I can have someone reach out.

config.brand_voice: Warm, concise, professional. First person as Agent. Plain language, no hype, no emojis, at most one exclamation mark.
config.booking_policy: Bookings and reschedules go through the office; Agent does not confirm crews or times directly.

referral_program.description: Refer a friend or neighbor who books a job.
referral_program.reward_text: a thank-you gift from the team
referral_program.terms_summary: Reward sends after the referred job is completed and paid. One reward per referred household.

escalation_rules: Any mention of property damage, injury, billing dispute, or legal action goes to a human immediately.
Two or more unresolved issues on one contact escalates.
approved_phrases: Glad the crew took care of everything.
I've flagged that for the team.
The office will follow up with you.
Really appreciate you spreading the word.

sample_replies: Glad the crew took care of everything - thanks for the note.
Thanks for flagging that. I've passed it to the team and the office will follow up.
